purpose: Fresh proof of automatic producer-independent BSON verifier acquisition after explicit independence semantics were added.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE.json containing exactly four records with fields id and text: 1 alpha, 2 beta, 3 gamma, 4 delta. Encode those exact records as BSON and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_INDEPENDENT_RECORDS.bson. Independently decode the BSON artifact using an implementation that is not provided by the BSON producer package, and verify the decoded records are exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE.json in values, order, field names, and record count.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/state/ASTRA-RUNTIME-INDEPENDENT-CODEC-VERIFIER-BSON-002.json')
x=json.loads(p.read_text())
hist=x.get('history') or []
assert hist,x
trace=(hist[0].get('result') or {}).get('trace') or []
steps=[t for t in trace if (t.get('plan') or {}).get('type')=='verify_with_independent_pypi_codec']
assert len(steps)==1,trace
result=steps[0].get('result') or {}
assert result.get('verified') is True,result
assert result.get('producer_independent') is True,result
assert result.get('dependency_independent') is True,result
assert result.get('producer_project')!=result.get('verifier_project'),result
print('INDEPENDENT_CODEC_VERIFIER_IMPLEMENTATION_VERIFIED')
PY
